questions.stem: 在被要求將文物歸還原屬國時，許多博物館發現，拖得越久，受到的批評就越強烈。
questions.answer: When asked to return cultural objects to their home countries, many museums find that the longer they delay, the fiercer the criticism becomes.
accepted_answers: When asked to give cultural objects back to their countries of origin, many museums discover that the longer they wait, the stronger the criticism grows.
When asked to return cultural objects to their countries of origin, many museums realize that the longer they put it off, the harsher the criticism they receive.

patterns: 間接問句（值多少錢／屬於哪裡：how much … / where …）
最高級（最根本的問題：the most fundamental issue）

1.explanation_zh: 「在被要求…時」博物館是被要求的一方，用「連接詞＋過去分詞」When asked to …，等於 When they are asked to …；省略的主詞必須和主要子句的主詞（many museums）相同。「拖得越久，批評就越強烈」用 the longer they delay, the fiercer the criticism becomes，兩個子句都以 the＋比較級開頭。「原屬國」是 home countries／countries of origin，「批評」用名詞 criticism。
evidence: 在被要求將文物歸還原屬國時
拖得越久，受到的批評就越強烈
1.strategy_zh: 先寫主幹 many museums find that …，that 子句裡放「越…越…」；句首的時間子句簡化成 When asked to …。
hints: 切成四段：在被要求將文物歸還原屬國時／許多博物館發現／拖得越久／受到的批評就越強烈
標的詞彙：return（歸還）、cultural（文化的）、museum（博物館）、criticism（批評）、fierce（強烈的）
句型框架：When asked to VR …, S + find that the + 比較級 + S + V, the + 比較級 + S + V

2.explanation_zh: 「最根本的問題」用最高級 the most fundamental issue（或 the most basic question），「問題」是要討論的議題，用 issue／question，不用 problem。「不是…而是…」用 not A but B，A、B 都是間接問句：how much these objects are worth（值多少錢用 be worth）、where they truly belong（belong 後面不加 to），語序都是直述句。
evidence: 不是這些文物值多少錢，而是它們真正屬於哪裡
2.strategy_zh: 主幹是 the most fundamental issue is not A but B；A、B 各自寫成 wh- 名詞子句，注意不要用疑問句語序。
hints: 切成四段：在這場爭議中／最根本的問題／不是這些文物值多少錢／而是它們真正屬於哪裡
標的詞彙：dispute（爭議）、fundamental（根本的）、issue（議題）、worth（值…錢）、belong（屬於）
句型框架：the most + adj. + N + is not how much + S + be worth but where + S + V

common_errors.wrong: When asking to return cultural objects to their home countries
common_errors.right: When asked to return cultural objects to their home countries
common_errors.explanation_zh: 博物館是「被要求」的一方，要用過去分詞 asked；asking 是主動「要求別人」。

common_errors.wrong: When asked to return cultural objects to their original countries
common_errors.right: When asked to return cultural objects to their home countries
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「原屬國」是 home country 或 country of origin；original country 不是道地說法。
主詞 museums 是複數，動詞不加 s。

accepted: the longer they put it off

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「越…越…」兩個子句都要以 the＋比較級開頭。

accepted: the harsher the criticism they receive

common_errors.wrong: the more strong the criticism becomes

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「批評」在這裡是名詞 criticism，不是動詞 criticize。

traps.explanation_zh: 「受到的批評」是抽象名詞 criticism，寫成 the fiercer the criticism becomes；把「受到批評」直接翻成 get criticize 會同時錯在詞性與被動。

traps.literal_error: When asking to return cultural objects to their home countries, many museums find that the longer they delay, the fiercer the criticism becomes.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文有「被」：博物館是被要求的一方，要用過去分詞 When asked to …；寫成 When asking 意思變成博物館去要求別人。

bonus.text: When asked to return cultural objects to their home countries, many museums learn that every year of delay only invites fiercer criticism.
bonus.explanation_zh: 把「拖得越久，批評越強烈」改寫成 every year of delay only invites fiercer criticism（每拖一年只會招來更強烈的批評），用抽象名詞當主詞，句子更精簡。

1.restructuring_zh: 「在被要求…時」省略主詞與 be 動詞，寫成 When asked to …（省略的主詞要和主要子句的 many museums 相同）；「受到的批評就越強烈」以「批評」為主詞，寫成 the fiercer the criticism becomes，比較級要移到子句開頭。

patterns.label_zh: 最高級（最根本的問題：the most fundamental issue）

common_errors.explanation_zh: 介系詞 in 後面接名詞 dispute／debate；argue 是動詞。
這裡的「問題」是要討論的議題，用 issue／question；problem 是要解決的麻煩。
多音節形容詞的最高級用 the most，不加 -est。

parts.zh: 不是這些文物值多少錢
accepted: is not how much these objects are worth
is not how valuable these cultural objects are
is not what these cultural objects are worth
is not how much these cultural objects are worth

common_errors.wrong: is not how much money these objects value
common_errors.right: is not how much these objects are worth
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「值多少錢」用 be worth：how much they are worth；value 當動詞是「重視、估價」。

common_errors.wrong: is not how much are these objects worth
common_errors.right: is not how much these objects are worth
common_errors.explanation_zh: 名詞子句用直述句語序：how much＋主詞＋be worth。

parts.zh: 而是它們真正屬於哪裡

common_errors.wrong: but where do they truly belong
common_errors.explanation_zh: 間接問句不用疑問句語序。

common_errors.wrong: but where they truly belong to
common_errors.explanation_zh: where 已經表示地點，belong 後面不再加 to。

traps.explanation_zh: 中文的「問題」可以是 problem、question 或 issue；這裡指爭議裡要討論的核心議題，用 issue／question，寫成 problem 意思就偏了。

traps.literal_error: is not how much money these objects value
traps.explanation_zh: 「值多少錢」英文用 be worth：how much these objects are worth；直譯成 how much money … value 是錯誤搭配。

bonus.text: What matters most in this dispute is not how much these objects are worth but where they truly belong.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 What matters most … is …（準分裂句）強調「最重要的是」，是作文也常用的加分句型。

1.translation: When asked to return artifacts to their countries of origin, many museums have found that the longer they delay, the stronger the criticism they receive.
1.explanation_zh: 「在被要求…時」用省略主詞與 be 動詞的 When asked to…；「原屬國」countries of origin；「拖得越久，受到的批評就越強烈」用 the + 比較級…, the + 比較級…，後半 the stronger the criticism (that) they receive 省略 is；「發現」用現在完成式表至今的經驗。

2.translation: In this controversy, the most fundamental question is not how much these artifacts are worth but where they truly belong.
2.explanation_zh: 「不是…而是…」用 not A but B，A、B 都是名詞子句（間接問句）how much these artifacts are worth／where they truly belong，結構對稱；「最根本的問題」the most fundamental question。

issues_zh: 我把「文物」譯成 artifacts（return artifacts to their countries of origin），這是英文談文物歸還時最常用的字，但第 1 部分 accepted 全是 cultural objects，標的詞 cultural 也沒有 alternatives，所以照規準不在可接受寫法內。建議 cultural 補 alternatives artifact／relic／heritage，第 1 部分 accepted 補 return artifacts／cultural relics to their countries of origin。
「許多博物館發現」我用現在完成式 have found；accepted 只列現在式 find／discover／realize，這是非標的的時態差異，不影響判斷，但可順手補上。
標的詞彙我用到 4/5（80%），剛好在門檻上。
（參考）第 3 部分我寫 how much these artifacts are worth，accepted 只有 objects／cultural objects；這裡「文物」不是標的詞，句型 NCL 與標的詞 worth 都對，所以仍算在可接受寫法內。建議一併補 artifacts。

problems: 第 1 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義

1.translation: When asked to return cultural relics to the countries they originally belonged to, many museums have found that the longer they delay, the stronger the criticism they receive becomes.
1.explanation_zh: 「在被要求……時」用省略主詞的 When asked to...；「越……越……」用 the longer..., the stronger...；「文物」譯成 cultural relics（亦可 artifacts）；「原屬國」用關係子句說明。句尾的 becomes 讓結構完整，但略顯累贅，也可改成 the more strongly they are criticized。

2.translation: In this controversy, the most fundamental issue is not how much these artifacts are worth, but where they really belong.
2.explanation_zh: 「不是……而是……」用 not ... but ...，兩側都接名詞子句 how much ... worth 與 where they belong；「最根本的問題」用最高級 the most fundamental issue；「爭議」譯成 controversy。

issues_zh: 「文物」我自然寫成 cultural relics；參考譯文與各部分 accepted 一律用 cultural objects，relics／artifacts 這兩個比 objects 更常見的譯法都沒收，建議補入 cultural relics、artifacts（Q2 同樣的問題）。
「原屬國」我寫成 the countries they originally belonged to，不在第 1 部分 accepted 內（只有 their home countries／their countries of origin）；另外「發現」我用現在完成式 have found，accepted 只收現在式 find／discover／realize，建議補現在完成式。
我最後的 the stronger the criticism they receive becomes 有點累贅（屬於我自己的寫法問題，不是 rubric 問題）。
「文物」我寫 these artifacts，第 3 部分 accepted 只有 these objects／these cultural objects；artifacts 是更常見的說法，建議補入 artifacts、relics。
另：第 2 題 items 缺少 restructuring_zh 欄位（第 1 題有），格式不一致。
